review: Reviewed the retained round-13 pause of Sol: two consecutive ordinary decisions were rejected by validation. ordinary-52 returned a plan with a tell text longer than the 240-character bound ("tell text is limited to 240 characters") and ordinary-53 returned a plan that did not match the registered task plan shape. Both responses, their usage and their reservations remain charged; neither call is resent. This is model-output rejection, not a provider transport failure, so it is a counted handoff under the protocol. The recovery installs no package, assigns no interface, reviews no request and changes no source, budget or experimental policy. Sol makes a fresh decision with a separate charge.
